tools.name: reflect_full_text
tools.label: Reflect the whole text
tools.description: Read a presented whole — a claim, an answer, a passage, your own composition — through all twelve MEF lenses, each run across its six sub-slots. Returns, for every lens, how strongly the subject stands at each sub-slot; several can hold at once, so each lens comes back as a profile, not a single cell. It shows what a thought is doing across the whole lens field: where it questions, what causes it names, how it moves, what it is in time. Use it to see a thought before answering from it, or to check your own composition against what it carries. Put your own reading in own_disclosure; the instrument weighs it but reads independently.
prompt_guidelines: Relational contract: the P positions P0–P5 and their conjugates P0′–P5′ are purely relational responsibilities in the recurrence of work; they hold no inherent manifest content. The twelve MEF lenses are the refraction media of these positions: whatever content a position carries is read through a lens, and a lens reading is always of a position's responsibility — never of the thing itself. Readings inform; the work remains yours.

The Night reflect tools read any thought — the person's words, your own answer, a summary — through the MEF lenses. Take a reading when seeing what a thought carries would change what you say; the reading is yours to think and answer through.

tools.name: reflect_right_frame
tools.label: Reflect the right frame
tools.description: Choose the one lens that, taken up now, does the most work on a subject. It needs the lens field read first: a reflect_full_text reading, or square readings covering at least half the lenses. Returns the chosen lens with the full ranking of the twelve. Your candidate frame may ride in own_disclosure.

tools.name: reflect_resonant_frames
tools.label: Reflect the resonant frames
tools.description: Weigh each of the twelve lenses on its own as a frame in play for a subject, and rank them: which frames bear on it now and how strongly, to see which to take deeper. Your candidate frames may ride in own_disclosure.
